about: Per-agent WIP caps, enforced on new work since 2026-11-22 (Tim: "Do all three", cap open work per agent; supersedes the 2026-10-12 no-ceiling rule). A producer is the branch prefix. At its cap, a producer's new intake (lanes) and new PRs (pr-open) are refused with reason wip-cap and the PRs to land first; repairs of existing PRs never consult the cap. Producers in perSession share one prefix across many concurrent sessions, so each session is capped at perSessionCap through the agent-session body marker; their producer cap is only a backstop. Held, repair-exhausted, escalated and queue-poisoned PRs are handed off and do not count. Quota and CI capacity still gate first.

expire.about: Off until JOV-INV-011 (automaticCloseRequiresExplicitDuplicateLabel) is amended by the founder; until then `python3 scripts/lanes/pr_wip.py expire` lists candidates and `--apply` is an explicit, authorized run.
